facts.fact: La Gazette des Comores reports on 28 August 2026 that the civil registration system is still largely dependent on old paper registers, which the AMECC project aims to modernise progressively.
The AMECC civil registration modernisation project is carried by the Ministry of the Interior, with the support of international partners, notably the French embassy and UNICEF.
facts.system: AMECC (Appui à la Modernisation de l'État civil aux Comores)

facts.fact: On 28 August 2026 AMECC held a consultation at Fomboni town hall, Mohéli, with midwives, village chiefs, cadis and mayors on births, deaths and marriages, a first stocktaking step to continue in Djando district and Nioumachoi before other actions such as awareness caravans.
